column1: # render rules 4, 9 and 12 under the look-alike readings of the persona
# NameTexts): one row per class of spelling a name can hide behind and per
# place a page or the feed shows it, on a copy of render/pass-report-pins,
# the real fixture build (search_cases_runner, label render-persona).
# Visible personas there: persona-1 (Avery Exampleton, aliases
# "A. Exampleton" and "Avery E.") and persona-3 (Riley Placeholder, the
# hidden. Columns: name, file, find, replace, expect; a code point is
# written \u{XXXX}, and find + creates the file. The R0 rows expect the
# message of before the readings; the others its LOOKALIKE_NOTE or
# DRAWN_NOTE. The other-persona rows add a second visible persona whose
# name has the skeleton of an existing name: its own page is missing (rule
# 1), and the existing persona's own box holds its name, which has no
# exemption there (a documented false positive of the readings, ADR-0004
# part 5); the one-token name "Zoë" with a Cyrillic o meets persona-3's
# labelled box, where the label follows it, so only the feed (rule 12)
# shows it bare. The fix-round-1 rows: U+00D7 is a separator only for R0
# (the skeleton reads it as "x"); U+0307 and U+0301 are combining marks the
# names drop; U+01C0 and the palochka draw as a stroke, which the stroke
# reading R3 takes for the space; the label-* rows spell the label so that
# only the reading named keeps the name bare; the rtl-reversed-pipe rows
# need V3; and "Ali" next to the "all" of the fixed copy passes, with
# exactly the 6 record-and-page findings of an alias the pages do not show.
# pass-label-read-with-the-name-reading: the readings that find this name
# (R2, R3) read the label's capital I as its i, so the name is labelled.
# Fix round 2: a written l in a word of capitals reads as the capital I
# (caps-l), U+4E28 and the strokes the table maps to it are strokes, an
# enclosing mark (Me) drops like any other mark, and a stroke is no outer
# boundary of a name: the alias "Tem" next to the JSON-LD type "ListItem"
# passes (rule 9 for the hidden persona, rule 4 for the visible one).
